source: NOAA NCEI Monterey 2012 Coastal DEM, 1/3 arc-second MHW (DEM 3545), ArcGIS raster 93
gridRegistration: pixel centers; values row-major south-to-north, west-to-east
resampling: bilinear via NOAA ArcGIS exportImage; native source grid approximately 8.2m east-west and10.3m north-south
notes: Integrated bathymetry/topography compiled from multiple surveys and interpolation; not live soundings. No sediment classes implied. MHW is a tidal datum; live Santa Cruz predictions available only in MLLW and must not be added without verified conversion.
